name: Yuuin no Toriko ~Main no Utage yori~
original_name: 憂淫の虜～魔淫の宴より～
source:
Takahiro Fujisawa is an ordinary young man who secretly insults and tortures women. He has always been successful and avoided sentence. He is appointed by his uncle as an insurance doctor to a girls school. This is an ideal hunting ground for him.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
藤泽贵弘是一个暗中凌辱和折磨女性的普通年轻人。他一直很成功，从未受到制裁。他被叔叔指派为一所女子学校的校医。对他来说，这是一个理想的狩猎场。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
